features.vestingText: Vesting in the Company’s employer matching and profit-sharing contributions and the earnings thereon is based on years of continuous service.
features.eligibilityText: All employees who have completed 6 months of service, as defined, are eligible to participate, provided they are at least 21 years of age.
features.loansText: Notes Receivable - Participant Loans Effective January 1, 2007, a participant may borrow from his or her account a minimum of $1,000 up to a maximum equal to the lesser of $50,000 or 50 percent of their vested account balance.
